N-1.1-A.skill: distinguish average speed (path length) from average velocity (signed displacement) when the motion reverses direction

N-1.1-B.skill: predict how reversing the axis direction or origin changes signed quantities (position, displacement, velocity, acceleration) but not magnitudes

N-1.2-A.skill: use the relative signs of velocity and acceleration to decide speeding up or slowing down, then apply v = v0 + at through a reversal

N-1.2-B.skill: separate displacement from distance traveled for constant-acceleration motion that reverses at a turning point

N-1.3-A.skill: read position from the signed area under a velocity-time graph, distinguishing zero velocity and a turning point from zero or maximum displacement

N-1.3-B.skill: compare slopes (instantaneous versus average velocity) of straight and curved position-time graphs

N-1.4-A.skill: combine and subtract signed velocities in one dimension across two or three reference frames

N-1.4-B.skill: identify which quantities are invariant between frames moving at constant relative velocity (acceleration, time) and which are frame-dependent (velocity, path, distance)

N-1.5-A.skill: resolve projectile velocity into independent horizontal (constant) and vertical (g-accelerated) components past the apex, with acceleration still g

N-1.5-B.skill: compare range, time of flight, and maximum height for complementary launch angles at equal speed
